page_title: BET 2-1 VAL | Betis v Valencia 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Yellow card! It's like Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jose Sanchez agrees and books him.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90+5' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 15:12.
90+1' Here is a change. Antony is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Angel Ortiz (Betis).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Diego Llorente is given a rest as he is replaced by Valentin Gomez (Betis).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' 2 - 1 Goal! Pablo Fornals (Betis) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
81' Jose Copete is being substituted because of an injury. Carlos Corberan sends Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) on the pitch.
80' Jose Copete (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
78' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
78' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
77' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diego Lopez (Valencia) replacing Luis Rioja.
72' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Lucas Beltran and he is replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
72' Substitution. Pepelu makes way for Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia).
72' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
71' Marc Bartra (Betis) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.

68' What a poor attempt! Nelson Deossa (Betis) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
67' That's the end of the game for Chimy Avila, who is replaced by Pablo Garcia (Betis).
65' The total number of attempts is 7:13.
63' Pepelu (Valencia) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

60' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Alvaro Valles makes a comfortable save.
58' The game is interrupted now, Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Pablo Fornals (Betis) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
55' Antony (Betis) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
55' The corner from Antony (Betis) is hurriedly cleared.
54' Nelson Deossa (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
53' It must be a yellow card. It is. Pepelu (Valencia) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
50' Eray Comert (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
49' Valencia have a corner.
49' A pass lands at the feet of Lucas Beltran (Valencia) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
48' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marc Bartra (Betis) and blew his whistle.
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sergi Altimira as he is replaced by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
39' Wasted effort! Nelson Deossa (Betis) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
38' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Luis Rioja (Valencia) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
37' Jose Gaya (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:5.
31' Diego Llorente (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

27' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Chimy Avila (Betis) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Stole Dimitrievski.
23' Chimy Avila (Betis) is going to take the penalty!
22' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jose Copete (Valencia). Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Betis!

20' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Luis Rioja (Valencia) fires a brilliant volley into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Lucas Beltran provided the assist. What a finish! 0:1.
18' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles past the right post.
14' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
13' Pepelu (Valencia) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Alvaro Valles leaps out to thwart his attempt.
13' Pepelu (Valencia) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
12' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Valencia!
11' Antony (Betis) is flagged for offside.
10' Jose Copete (Valencia) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
9' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to send the ball in.
7' Golden chance! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
5' The resulting corner from Jose Gaya (Valencia) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
